name: Syntonic Limited
summary: Syntonic Limited engages in the commercialization of mobile services for telecommunication carriers in Australia. The company's primary technology is the Revenue Generation Platform (RGP), a cloud-based solution that offers mobile advertising through content monetization and mobile commerce. Its RGP helps broadcasters, game and app developers, sports organizations, and media companies to productize, package, and monetize their content for mobile consumers. In addition, the company provides Captive Portal solutions; and international roaming and customized app bundle solutions. Syntonic Limited was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Seattle, Washington.
